metadata.question: Did the land area of Smith Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting land area changes on Smith Island between 1999 and 2019. This requires: 1. Finding Smith Island location - I'll need to search for it 2. Using satellite imagery from both time periods 3. Detecting land vs water to calculate area 4. Comparing the areas For land/water classification, I can use: - NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to distinguish water from land - Or use band thresholds - Landsat imagery would be good for this time range Strategy: 1. Find Smith Island location (I'll search for a known Smith Island) 2. Use Landsat 5 for 1999 and Landsat 8 for 2019 3. Calculate water area using NDWI 4. Subtract from total area to get land area 5. Compare the two years I need to handle: - Cloud masking - Checking for valid data - Validating results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Smith Island, Maryland (Chesapeake Bay) const smithIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([-76.015, 37.983]); const bufferRegion = smithIsland.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the island // Time periods const start1999 = '1999-06-01'; const end1999 = '1999-09-30'; const start2019 = '2019-06-01'; const end2019 = '2019-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1999, Landsat 8 for 2019 function getLandsatCollection(startDate, endDate, collectionId) { return ee.ImageCollection(collectionId) .filterBounds(bufferRegion) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); } const landsat5_1999 = getLandsatCollection(start1999, end1999, 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'); const landsat8_2019 = getLandsatCollection(start2019, end2019, 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'); // Check collection sizes const size1999 = landsat5_1999.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = landsat8_2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images: ${size1999}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size1999 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const composite1999 = landsat5_1999.median(); const composite2019 = landsat8_2019.median(); // Function to calculate land area using NDWI function calculateLandArea(image, year) { // Calculate NDWI for water detection let ndwi; if (year === 1999) { // Landsat 5: Green = B2, NIR = B4 ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDWI'); } else { // Landsat 8: Green = B3, NIR = B5 ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); } // Classify: NDWI > 0 = water, NDWI <= 0 = land const landMask = ndwi.lte(0); // Calculate land area in square meters const area = landMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const stats = area.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: bufferRegion, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.get('NDWI'); } // Calculate land areas const landArea1999 = calculateLandArea(composite1999, 1999); const landArea2019 = calculateLandArea(composite2019, 2019); // Get results const area1999 = landArea1999.getInfo(); const area2019 = landArea2019.getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Land Area: ${area1999 ? (area1999 / 1000000).toFixed(2) : 'N/A'} km²`); console.log(`2019 Land Area: ${area2019 ? (area2019 / 1000000).toFixed(2) : 'N/A'} km²`); // Validation if (area1999 === null || area2019 === null || isNaN(area1999) || isNaN(area2019) || area1999 <= 0 || area2019 <= 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare areas - if 2019 area is less than 1999, land decreased const percentChange = ((area2019 - area1999) / area1999 * 100); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(1)}%`); // Consider decrease if area reduced by more than 1% (to account for minor variations) if (area2019 < area1999 * 0.99) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
